checks: Standalone Blazor WASM starts from static hosting with no renderer Node runtime or desktop path UI.
The actual OS folder picker grants a live external vault, including binary attachment inventory.
Real CodeMirror typing and Ctrl+S preserve exact UTF-8 BOM, CRLF and Unicode in the original file.
External LF/CRLF changes reconfigure CodeMirror without changing the next save's line-ending style.
The shared note-creation UI creates folders and writes a new Markdown note directly to disk.
Desktop-only plugins are unavailable and Node-dependent plugins fail visibly without executing past require.
Core enablement and the unchanged upstream sample plugin save settings into the selected vault.
Page reload reconnects an IndexedDB directory handle and restores layout, core state and exact disk content.
External edits refresh clean buffers; stale saves fail without overwriting disk or discarding unsaved text.
A real page reload is blocked while a buffer has unsaved changes.
Cancelling the native folder picker retains the selected vault and dirty buffer.
Vault switching isolates core settings, and Create vault creates a real subfolder in the selected parent.
A new vault required explicit community-plugin opt-in, stored separately without creating or resetting an enabled-ID file.
inputEnvironment: Windows occlusion and renderer/timer background throttling disabled in disposable UI processes; production launch is unchanged.
